1965.text: The New Law or the Law of the Gospel is the perfection here on earth of the divine law, natural and revealed.
1965.notes: Quoted sentence only. First sentence; para. continues: work of Christ, expressed in the Sermon on the Mount; work of the Spirit, the interior law of charity (cites Heb 8:8,10 / Jer 31:31-33). Ch. 12 line 145.
